goals: Provide a reliable 1:1 counseling booking system with SQLite persistence.
Ensure atomic booking operations to prevent double-booking.
Implement a strict verification mechanism for booking lookups and cancellations using client emails.
Maintain a clear separation between slot availability and booking records.

steps: Counselor calls add_available_slot with counselor_id and start_time.
Client calls query_available_slots to find an open slot.
Client calls create_booking with slot details and personal info.
System validates slot availability, marks it booked, and returns a booking_id.
Client calls lookup_booking with booking_id and email.
System verifies email and returns booking details.
Client calls cancel_booking with booking_id and email.
System verifies email, updates booking status to CANCELLED, and marks the slot as available.

states: CONFIRMED: The booking is active and the slot is occupied.
CANCELLED: The booking is void and the slot is returned to availability.

business_rules: A slot can only be booked if is_booked is False.
Booking creation must be atomic (Slot update and Booking record creation).
Lookup and Cancellation require the client_email to match the record associated with the booking_id.
Cancelling a booking must immediately set the associated slot's is_booked status to False.
Slot queries can be filtered by counselor_id and/or date (YYYY-MM-DD).
ui_views: API-only service: No UI views defined. Interface is provided via CounselingService class methods.
edge_cases: Concurrent booking requests for the same slot (handled via SQLite transactions).
Attempting to book a slot that does not exist.
Attempting to cancel a booking with an incorrect email address.
Querying slots for a date with no available appointments.
design_decisions: Use SQLite for lightweight, file-based persistence.
Use UUIDs for booking_id to ensure uniqueness and prevent predictable ID enumeration.
Store timestamps as ISO 8601 strings to maintain timezone offsets (Asia/Seoul).
Implement custom domain exceptions for clear error handling (e.g., SlotAlreadyBookedError, AuthenticationError).
assumptions: The system assumes the input start_time is already validated as ISO 8601.
The system assumes a single-process or SQLite-safe multi-process environment.

database_ddl: CREATE TABLE slots (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, counselor_id TEXT NOT NULL, start_time TEXT NOT NULL, is_booked INTEGER DEFAULT 0);
CREATE TABLE bookings (booking_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slot_id INTEGER NOT NULL, client_name TEXT NOT NULL, client_email TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(slot_id) REFERENCES slots(id));
CREATE INDEX idx_slots_counselor_time ON slots(counselor_id, start_time);

methods.name: add_available_slot
methods.signature: def add_available_slot(self, counselor_id: str, start_time: str) -> None:
methods.description: Adds a new available slot to the database.

methods.name: query_available_slots
methods.signature: def query_available_slots(self, counselor_id: Optional[str] = None, date: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Slot]:
methods.description: Returns a list of unbooked slots based on filters.

methods.name: create_booking
methods.signature: def create_booking(self, counselor_id: str, start_time: str, client_name: str, client_email: str) -> str:
methods.description: Books a slot. Returns booking_id. Raises SlotAlreadyBookedError or SlotNotFoundError.

methods.name: lookup_booking
methods.signature: def lookup_booking(self, booking_id: str, client_email: str) -> Booking:
methods.description: Retrieves booking details. Raises AuthenticationError or BookingNotFoundError.

methods.name: cancel_booking
methods.signature: def cancel_booking(self, booking_id: str, client_email: str) -> None:
methods.description: Cancels booking and re-opens slot. Raises AuthenticationError or BookingNotFoundError.

exceptions: SlotNotFoundError: Raised when the specified counselor/time combination does not exist.
SlotAlreadyBookedError: Raised when the slot is already marked as booked.
BookingNotFoundError: Raised when the booking_id does not exist.
AuthenticationError: Raised when the provided email does not match the booking record.
